name: Window Peer Frame Exclusion: EXCLUDE GROUP for Clean Cross-Group Contrast
description: When comparing sales across product categories or dates, analysts want to compute the average of all other groups, strictly excluding the entire current group.
prompt:
When comparing sales across product categories or dates, analysts want to compute the average of all other groups, strictly excluding the entire current group.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: region, order_id, sale_amount, other_regions_baseline_avg.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Compute baseline average across other regions strictly excluding current region group
            SELECT 
                region,
                order_id,
                sale_amount,
                ROUND(AVG(sale_amount) OVER (
                    ORDER BY region
                    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
                    EXCLUDE GROUP
                ), 2) AS other_regions_baseline_avg
            FROM regional_orders
            ORDER BY region, order_id;
why_it_fails: Computing group baselines without excluding the current group dilutes contrast in small sample sizes.
